roadmap.title: Forest and Farm
roadmap.description: Start the journey, repair the windmill, explore the Fire Lookout, and start the long counters: litter, caps, and crops.

roadmap.title: The Coast
roadmap.description: Enter the Coast, adopt and pet the dog, solve the gear puzzle, fix the lighthouse, and get the clothing cabinet.

roadmap.title: The Canyons
roadmap.description: Enter the Canyons, faint, ride the balloon, repaint the van, and repair the ferry.

roadmap.title: The Mountains and cleanup
roadmap.description: Cross to the Mountains, pull every festival lever, finish the festival, then clear the collectibles and upgrades.

achievements.description: Start your journey in the outdoors.
achievements.summary: Lift the barrier at the end of the starting parking lot to begin the journey.

steps.text: Drive to the first parking lot, get out, and light the campfire with wood from the supply cache next to it.
Download Basic Tools from the signal tower on the left, then craft the Wrench in the van's trunk.
Lift the barrier.

achievements.summary: Drive from Forest and Farm into the Coast.

steps.text: Break the rocks blocking the Forest and Farm exit.
Drive through the exit and down the road.

achievements.summary: Drive from the Coast into the Canyons.

steps.text: Craft 3 Electronics and 2 battery components.
Clear the vines in front of the Coast exit, repair the console there, and pull the lever.
Drive through the exit.

achievements.summary: Cross the ferry from the Canyons to the Mountains.

steps.text: Repair the ferry.
Drive onto the ferry and ram the far wall to be moved to the Mountains.
Drive forward a little.

achievements.description: Build the maximum weight on top of your vehicle.
achievements.summary: Fill the van's weight bar by building the maximum weight on top of it.

steps.text: Build wooden floors on top of the van until the weight bar in the top left is full.

achievements.summary: Pet your dog companion.

steps.text: Walk up to your dog, open its command wheel, and choose Pet.

achievements.summary: Repair the windmill so its sails turn.

guide.context: The hill road to the windmill stalls the van until you craft the first Motor Upgrade. The repair uses 20 Scrap Metal, which is heavy, so leave other items in the van.

steps.text: Craft Motor Upgrade 1: download the Vehicle Research Station blueprint at the signal tower north of the fields, build the station (4 Scrap Metal, 4 Everwood Planks) and a Bolt Press (7 Scrap Metal), put 30 Scrap Metal in the Bolt Press, then research and craft the upgrade.
Drive up to the windmill and go up the stairs inside to the panel with two levers.
Pull the left lever once, climb the ladder, climb the boxes, and hit the switch near the roof to drop a second ladder.
Climb the new ladder to the top floor. If it is out of reach, move the levers until the ladders line up.
Behind the brake lever, repair the cogwheel with 20 Scrap Metal.
Pull the brake lever.

achievements.summary: Repair the lighthouse and turn on its beacon.

steps.text: Repair the broken bridge to the lighthouse with 10 Redwood Planks.
Go inside. On the top floor, pull the lever with the down arrow to lower the bulb one floor.
On the middle floor, pull the down lever. On the ground floor, pull the left lever to slide the bulb to the repair bench.
Repair the bulb with 3 Electronics.
Pull the right lever to slide the bulb back, then the up lever on the ground floor and the up lever on the middle floor.
On the top floor, pull the rotation lever (circular arrow).

achievements.description: Get the ferry back in operation.
achievements.summary: Repair the Canyons ferry so it can carry the van.

guide.context: The ferry is near the Sickle 3 tower and Campfire 53 at the top of the road.

steps.text: Craft 4 casings, 2 Electronics, and 2 hardened metal, then repair the ferry's motor.
Craft 6 strong weave and 6 hyper thread.
Repair the transport balloons on both sides of the ferry.

achievements.summary: Pull the levers at all 12 festival sites.

guide.context: Some sites have several levers. Pull every one.

achievements.description: Deliver all research material at the four research centers.
achievements.summary: Deliver all research items to the four domes of the Canyons Research Center.

guide.context: Dome 4 takes items found only in the Mountains, so finish this after reaching them. Keep a few of each plantable food rather than eating everything.

steps.text: Dome 1, in the right tent: deliver Sun Cap, Honey, Raw Coffee Beans, Sea Shell, and Coconut.
Dome 2, in the next tent west: deliver Cotton, Golden Bolete, Wild Tomatoes, Corn, and Red Ore.
Dome 3, in the third tent: deliver Coarse Ore, Fibre, Carrot, Indigo Cap, and Grain.
Dome 4, in the last tent under the satellite dish: deliver Bamboo, Cherries, Chrome Ore, Lotus Flower, and Pak Choi.

achievements.summary: Paint your vehicle 10 times.

guide.context: A repaint costs about 3 Paint, so plan for about 30 Paint.

steps.text: At the windmill, collect the Signal Decrypter (shelf left of the entrance), the floppy disk (top floor, on a crate) and the password (shelf in the room that opens once the mill runs), then download the Mortar and Pestle blueprint at the terminal and craft it.

At the lighthouse, collect the decryption item on the green table outside, the floppy disk on the second floor and the password on the floor to the right inside, then download the Paintbrush at the terminal.
Grind flower petals into Paint, drive to a painting station, and repaint the van 10 times.

achievements.summary: Solve the gear puzzle in the Coast cabin.

guide.context: Solving it also drains the cave west of the cabin, which holds a gnome.

steps.text: Go to the cabin with the gear rooms, west of Heartmoor Float Village.
Repair the empty cogwheel slot on the right.
Starting from the left, press the first cog once, the next cog once, the spinning cogs three times, and each of the next two cogs once.

achievements.summary: Recycle 100 pieces of litter in the van's recycler.

steps.text: Build a counter in the van, then build a Recycler on it.
Pick up litter around campsites and buildings, put it in the Recycler, and switch it on.
Keep going until you have recycled 100 pieces.

achievements.description: Craft the best available pants and clothing upgrades.
achievements.summary: Craft every shirt and pants upgrade.

guide.context: The first upgrades use thread, durathread, onyx minerals and seashells. Durathread comes from a spinning wheel and onyx minerals from a smasher.

steps.text: On the Coast, download the Gear Research Station from the signal tower and build it.
Research and craft Shirt Upgrades 1 and 2 and Pants Upgrade 1.
In the Canyons, craft Shirt Upgrade 3 and Pants Upgrade 2.
In the Mountains, craft Pants Upgrade 3. The achievement unlocks with the last upgrade.

achievements.description: Use the clothing cabinet to change into clothing with all different colors.
achievements.summary: Change into clothing with every color slot set to a new color at the clothing cabinet.

guide.context: Craft 1 Paint first: it needs the Mortar and Pestle blueprint from the windmill terminal and flower petals. The clothing cabinet blueprint comes from a signal tower on the Coast, and the cabinet costs 5 Redwood Planks.

steps.text: Open the clothing cabinet.
Change all eight colors: shirt main, shirt accent, gloves, fingernails, pants main, pants accent, shoes main, shoes accent.
Confirm the outfit.

achievements.description: Sow and harvest at least 30 crops.
achievements.summary: Plant and harvest 30 crops in total.

steps.text: Download the Gardening Plot from the signal tower on the cliff, then craft a watering can and plots.
Plant roadberries and water them; they are ready after you sleep.
Harvest, replant, and repeat until 30 crops are harvested.

achievements.summary: Explore the Fire Lookout Tower.

steps.text: Climb the Fire Lookout and take the floppy disk from the countertop inside.
Climb the balcony ladder to the roof and take the password and Signal Decrypter.
Use the terminal and download a blueprint.

achievements.summary: Adopt a dog at the Paws and Whiskers Lounge.

guide.context: You can adopt only one dog and cannot swap it later, so save before choosing.

steps.text: Drive from the Coast entrance to the Paws and Whiskers Lounge and go inside.
Walk through the building to the fenced yard.
Choose a dog, interact with it, type a name, and confirm.

achievements.summary: Collect at least 100 bottle caps.

guide.context: Caps lie near benches, houses, tables, and campsites. If the achievement does not unlock at 100, hold 100 caps at once before spending any.

steps.text: Loot caps near buildings and campsites as you travel until you have 100.

achievements.summary: Craft every available vehicle upgrade.

guide.context: Upgrades need Bolts, made by putting Scrap Metal into a Bolt Press. Scrap Metal respawns after you sleep twice, and towers and solar panels hold more.

steps.text: Build the Vehicle Research Station on a van counter after downloading its blueprint at a signal tower.

Keep researching and crafting at the station until nothing is left to craft. This includes the base Outdoor Building upgrade, Motor Upgrades 1 to 3, Battery Capacity Upgrades 1 to 3, Weight Capacity Upgrades 1 to 4, Outdoor Building Space Upgrades 1 to 3, and the Cooling System Upgrade.
The achievement unlocks with the last upgrade.

achievements.description: Cook all food recipes at least once.
achievements.summary: Cook every food recipe at least once.

guide.context: Build every cooking station first: the Baking Oven and Food Processor from earlier towers, plus the Cooking Pot, Tea Station, Cake Maker, Bread Press, Roasting Station and Coffee Station. The newer stations need silverbark, scrap, water, red ore, grain, bolts, sheet metal, coarse metal, and roasted coffee beans. The Coffee Machine recipe is made at the Coffee Station.

guide.context: Each machine takes bottle caps and gives a random blueprint; about 36 caps empty one machine, so about 288 for all eight. Machines sit two per area.

achievements.summary: Collect all 100 gnomes.

guide.context: The journal numbers gnomes 1 to 100 and lists them by area. Gnome 70 is last: it unlocks only after you bring five Mountains items back to the Canyons Research Center. Gnomes 85 and 86 are the developer gnomes. Gnomes 7, 9, 15, 17, 19, 21, 23 and 25 need Pickaxe 2 or Motor Upgrade 1 first. Most Canyons gnomes need Pickaxe 3, Motor Upgrade 2 and the Cooling System Upgrade, and gnomes 82, 97 and 100 need Motor Upgrade 3. Each entry lists what it needs.

achievements.summary: Faint in the Canyons.

guide.context: Fainting only returns you to your van with your items, so nothing is lost. The achievement may fail to unlock; if so, try again at a different campfire or with starvation or fall damage.

steps.text: In the Canyons, stand in a lit campfire until your health runs out.

achievements.description: Take a ride with the Hot Air Balloon.
achievements.summary: Ride the hot air balloon at the Red Ridge Airstrip.

steps.text: Go to the Red Ridge Airstrip in the Canyons and get into the hot air balloon.
Look up and light the balloon.

achievements.description: Collect the gnomes at the Gnome Workshop.
achievements.summary: Pick up the two developer gnomes at the Gnome Workshop.

steps.text: Enter the Gnome House at the top left of the Mountains map.
Pick up Marc and Tobi from the computer.

achievements.description: Have at least 10 Efficient Wind Turbines attached to your vehicle.
achievements.summary: Attach 10 or more Efficient Wind Turbines to the van.

guide.context: Ten turbines need 20 thread and 20 cloth, about 160 fibre.

steps.text: Download the Efficient Wind Turbine blueprint from the signal tower on the Coast.
Craft 10 Efficient Wind Turbines and attach them to the van.
